```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here()) # knit from project directory

library(tidyverse)
theme_set(ggthemes::theme_few())
```

# Load data

```{r}
f_flower <- list.files("alldata/input/NPN/flower/", full.names = T, recursive = T)
df_flower <- read_csv(f_flower) |>
  filter(phenophase_description == "Open flowers")

f_leaf <- list.files("alldata/input/NPN/leaf/", full.names = T, recursive = T)
df_leaf <- read_csv(f_leaf)
```

# Data cleaning

```{r}
source(here::here("code", "clean_data.R"))
source(here::here("code", "clean_by_resolving_conflict.R"))
source(here::here("code", "clean_by_leading_no.R"))
source(here::here("code", "clean_by_trailing_yes.R"))
source(here::here("code", "clean_by_window.R"))
```

```{r}
df_flower_clean <- df_flower |>
  clean_data(
    calculate_observation_option = "by_year",
    min_leading_no = 1,
    leading_window_days = 14,
    min_trailing_yes = 1,
    trailing_window_days = 14,
    max_doy = 213
  )

df_leaf_clean <- df_leaf |>
  clean_data(
    calculate_observation_option = "by_year",
    min_leading_no = 1,
    leading_window_days = 14,
    min_trailing_yes = 1,
    trailing_window_days = 14,
    max_doy = 213
  )
```

# Calculate FLS

```{r}
df_flower_onset_clean <- df_flower_clean |>
  calc_first_yes()
df_leaf_onset_clean <- df_leaf_clean |>
  calc_first_yes()
```

```{r}
df_fls <- inner_join(
  df_leaf_onset_clean |>
    select(latitude, longitude, genus, species, common_name, individual_id, year, leaf = day_of_first_yes),
  df_flower_onset_clean |>
    select(latitude, longitude, genus, species, common_name, individual_id, year, flower = day_of_first_yes)
) |>
  mutate(fls = leaf - flower)
```

# Explore latitudinal trend

## Within-species

```{r}
df_fls |>
  filter(genus == "Acer") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = latitude, y = fls)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_point(aes(col = species), alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_smooth(aes(col = species, group = species), method = MASS::rlm, se = F, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = MASS::rlm) +
  labs(x = "Latitude", y = "Leaf - Flower")
```

```{r}
lmerTest::lmer(fls ~ latitude + (1 + latitude | species), data = df_fls |> filter(genus == "Acer")) |> summary()
```

## Across species

Note that we should later use a better data source for species range.

```{r}
df_fls_sp <- df_fls |>
  filter(genus == "Acer") |>
  group_by(genus, species) |>
  summarize(latitude = median(latitude), fls = median(fls))

df_fls_sp |>
  ggplot(aes(x = latitude, y = fls)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_point(aes(col = species), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(aes(col = species), method = MASS::rlm, se = F) +
  geom_smooth(method = MASS::rlm) +
  labs(x = "Latitude", y = "Leaf - Flower")
```
```{r}
lm(fls ~ latitude, data = df_fls_sp) |> summary()
```
